notes: motion.max_flow is stored once (product scope, Bambu TPU 90A, 5.6 mm³/s on both nozzle sizes, wiki and store agree). The other published flows are not stored because one key holds one value per scope: 85A 2.2 (wiki) / 2.5 (store) mm³/s on 0.4 mm and 4.8 mm³/s on 0.6 mm; 95A HF 16 mm³/s on both (store only).
nozzle.diameter is per Size value; the kit value "High-flow TPU hotends (0.4 & 0.6 mm) with accessories" holds both sizes, so it gets no single-number row.
Loading (250 °C) and unloading (100 °C) temperatures in the wiki manual are procedure settings, not a maximum: thermal.max_nozzle_temp stays not_published.

The wiki manual also says: 85A TPU only with the H2D Flexible Filament Top-feed Rack; the TPU feed assist is recommended; the cutter cannot be used and the right nozzle loses automatic filament change/feed/retract; install only on the right nozzle. Not stored as specs (no registry key); kept here as evidence.
